reason: The README describes a workflow plugin centered on adversarial project inspection, issue reproduction, fixes, and post-fix review through three registered tools.

summaries.zh: 一个通过 checkup、fix 和 review 工具完成项目问题检查、修复交付与质量复查的工作流插件。
summaries.en: A workflow plugin that uses checkup, fix, and review tools to inspect projects, deliver fixes, and verify the results.

capabilities: Registers checkup, fix, and review tools
Orchestrates multiple specialized agents for inspection, implementation, verification, and review
Reads project targets and supporting context through the host workflow tools
May modify project artifacts when executing fix tasks
Produces issue lists, delivery reports, and review results
